title: Automations : Which line to delete
symptom: In automations, long pressing a line shows a delete icon but it is unclear which line will be deleted, as all active automations appear checked. The delete icon is missing on the tab when opening from the hamburger menu.
cause: The Remove/Sort option was duplicated and not working.
fix: The fix was a commit that removed the duplicated and non-working Remove/Sort option.
evidence_quote: Remove/Sort option was duplicated and not working https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/3a950bcd7f35db2d74cb17c32fbe70db0192d7a2
